The project has no headful self-verify harness and this chunk changes no screen. No dependency enters and no manifest changes, which the preservation entry holds; the audit leg is therefore not listed. **Not run locally:** the MSRV build and the windows, macos, ios and android matrix legs — the fork's CI run is their one witness, read after the operator pass; the three new check files carry no `cfg(unix)` gate, so the windows and macos jobs run them.

**The conformance reading has no listed entry, by construction** (steps 4 and 10; `inputs#I4`). It is report-only and grades no criterion; it is a before and an after around steps 5 and 6, and the wrap's light gate re-runs entries verbatim against a tree that no longer has a "before"; and it is bounded, so it may end as "not taken, cost measured". Its readings are `evidence/conformance.md`, written by implement. The fact it rests on, read at P4 with no clone and no build: the runner has no mode without a script engine — `blitz-vibey-script` is an unconditional dependency of it (`wpt/runner/Cargo.toml:17`) and a test that loads `/resources/testharness.js` is run by executing its JavaScript through that crate (`wpt/runner/src/test_runners/harness_test.rs:1-3`; classified at `test_runners/mod.rs:325-327`) — and a suite is any path under the checkout (`wpt/runner/src/main.rs:239-244`). This host held no checkout at P3 (`WPT_DIR` unset; none at `$HOME/dev/*/wpt`, `$HOME/dev/projects/wpt`, `$HOME/wpt`) and the fork's CI runs no WPT job, so the cost of the fetch and of the release build is what step 4 measures.

`evidence/controls.md` has no listed producer either, by construction: it is implement's record of step 9's one-shot readings — the red readings on the engine as built, which no entry can re-produce once the tree has moved, and the mutation controls; what it records is asserted by listed entries (the three new check files and the restated pair, under both builds).
